cues.en: The Chinese government really needs to do a better job of hiding information if they're gonna keep changing their story and blaming the coronavirus on other countries like Italy or The USA or Japan or whatever.
cues.zh: 如果中国政府要继续改口，把新冠病毒的锅甩给意大利、美国、日本之类的其他国家，那他们真得把信息藏得更严实一点才行。

cues.en: While I'm not a fan of theories or unproven scenarios, it's been impossible to avoid them in the outbreak of the coronavirus
cues.zh: 虽然我不喜欢阴谋论或未经证实的说法，但在新冠疫情暴发期间，这些说法根本躲不开，

cues.en: simply due to the fact that it was completely covered up in the beginning stages in China.
cues.zh: 原因很简单：疫情初期在中国被彻底掩盖了。

cues.en: This isn't really gonna be a theory. It's just public information I found.
cues.zh: 这期视频其实不算什么阴谋论，只是我查到的公开信息。

cues.en: When it broke, China was the first to jump onto the local Wuhan and Hubei government and villainize them until they had their perfect scapegoat.
cues.zh: 疫情暴发时，中国第一时间就把矛头对准武汉和湖北地方政府，把他们塑造成反派，直到凑出一个完美的替罪羊。

cues.en: This was, of course, preceded with the fact that we now know it wasn't just a local issue. It was in fact the way that the Chinese government was structured that led the top down leadership to stifle and prevent the release of any relevant information for months, which could have prevented this global pandemic.
cues.zh: 当然，在此之前我们已经知道，这根本不只是地方层面的问题。实际上正是中国政府的体制结构，使得自上而下的领导层在数月里压制并阻止任何相关信息的发布——而这些信息本可以阻止这场全球大流行。

cues.en: First and foremost, this is the Communist Party of China's fault.
cues.zh: 首先，这是中国共产党的责任。

cues.en: And the fact that there are people gasping for breath in their deathbed in your town is solely on the consciousness of the CCP
cues.zh: 如今你的镇上有人临终前还在挣扎着喘息，这完全要由中共的良知来买单，

cues.en: and the people who entrusted them to enter our global systems like the WHO.
cues.zh: 也要算在那些把他们送进WHO等全球体系、对其委以重任的人头上。

cues.en: The thing is after living in China for ten years and speaking fluent Chinese, you get to know a society pretty well. And let me tell you this, if you're applauding or admiring the political leadership of China, you're all diluted beyond belief.
cues.zh: 问题在于，在中国住了十年、又说着流利的中文，你会对一个社会了解得相当透彻。听我说一句：如果你还在鼓掌或钦佩中国的政治领导层，那你真是糊涂到家了。

cues.en: China doesn't operate like your country. The Chinese government is a face and greed driven government that relies on lies and bullying to maintain leadership. It's broken and fragile. So it doesn't surprise me that when I was doing my research in my last video, it wasn't hard to follow a paper trail left by the CCP themselves.
cues.zh: 中国的运作方式跟你的国家不一样。中国政府是一个被面子和贪婪驱动的政府，靠谎言和霸凌来维持统治。它既崩坏又脆弱。所以我做上一期视频的研究时，顺着中共自己留下的文件线索一路查下去毫不费力，这一点都不让我意外。

cues.en: In my last video, I found it very suspicious
cues.zh: 在上一期视频里，我觉得非常可疑的一点是，

cues.en: that the official Wuhan virology lab had a job opening 11/18/2019
cues.zh: 武汉官方病毒学研究所曾在2019年11月18日发布过一个招聘岗位，

cues.en: asking for scientists to come research the relationship between the coronavirus and bats,
cues.zh: 招募科学家来研究冠状病毒与蝙蝠之间的关系，

cues.en: specifically why they carry the virus, yet are long lived.
cues.zh: 具体来说就是为什么蝙蝠携带病毒却能长寿。

cues.en: It's no secret that longevity as well as other ailments are well studied in China, as can be seen by the ridiculous amounts of traditional Chinese medicines that supposedly treat them. Bare bile injections as state endorsed coronavirus cure anyone?
cues.zh: 在中国，长寿以及其他病症被广泛研究，这早已不是秘密——看看那些号称能治病的海量中药就知道了。熊胆注射液，国家背书的冠状病毒特效药，来一份？

cues.en: Anyway, while reading this job posting, I failed to notice until the next day that another job posting followed the previous post, and this is where it got big.
cues.zh: 总之，在读这份招聘启事的时候，我直到第二天才注意到前面那条招聘之后还跟着另一条招聘，事情从这里开始变大了。

cues.en: So when I examined the job posting, I noticed that there was actually a follow-up job posting on 12/24/2019.
cues.zh: 所以当我仔细研究这份招聘启事时，我发现2019年12月24日实际上还有一条后续招聘。

cues.en: And remember, this is before any news broke,
cues.zh: 要记住，这都是在任何消息传出之前，

cues.en: which basically says,
cues.zh: 基本上是说，

cues.en: we've discovered a new and terrible virus and would like to recruit people to come deal with it. I found this interesting because like I said, the news didn't come out about coronavirus until ages after that. So I decided to dig a little bit more into the staff. After all, they would have published articles being scientists. Turns out this woman, Shi Zhengli,
cues.zh: “我们发现了一种新型的可怕病毒，希望招募人员来处理它。”我觉得这很有意思，因为正如我所说，关于冠状病毒的消息直到很久之后才传出来。所以我决定再深入了解一下这些研究人员。毕竟，他们是科学家，应该发表过论文。结果发现，这位女性 Shi Zhengli，

cues.en: she was the lead researcher of the lab and she was famous for bat studies. They called her bat woman in some circles. She even received an award for approving bats are natural reservoirs of SARS like coronaviruses.
cues.zh: 是实验室的首席研究员，以蝙蝠研究闻名。在一些圈子里，人们叫她“蝙蝠女”。她甚至因为认定蝙蝠是 SARS 类冠状病毒的天然宿主而获奖。

cues.en: In November 2017 all the way through 2018,
she had already written three articles
cues.zh: 她已经发表了三篇论文，

cues.en: about how bats can transmit coronaviruses
cues.zh: 探讨蝙蝠如何传播冠状病毒

cues.en: to humans. This is all public knowledge. She and her team went south to Yunnan province all the way, you know, deep South of China. It's very beautiful there. And she found out that SARS like viruses
cues.zh: 给人类。这些都是公开信息。她和团队一路南下，去了云南省，也就是中国很南边的地方。那里非常美。她发现，SARS 类病毒

cues.en: originally came from bats in fact. In 2017,
cues.zh: 实际上最初来自蝙蝠。2017 年，

cues.en: from data taken from one of her studies in rural Yanan province, she took blood samples from two eighteen
cues.zh: 根据她在延安农村地区的一项研究所得数据，她采集了 218 名

cues.en: villagers.
cues.zh: 村民的血液样本。

cues.en: After testing it, it showed that SARS like viruses found in bats from nearby caves have a high potential to affect people. She predicted that humans coming into contact with bats would have a high chance of becoming infected.
cues.zh: 检测结果显示，附近洞穴蝙蝠携带的 SARS 类病毒很可能会影响人类。她预测，人类接触蝙蝠后，感染的可能性很高。

cues.en: After blood testing the two eighteen villagers, she found that six people in Yunnan were found to be infected.
cues.zh: 对这 218 名村民进行血液检测后，她发现云南有 6 人感染。

cues.en: She returned to Wuhan to the lab to continue studying SARS like coronaviruses
cues.zh: 她回到武汉的实验室，继续长期研究蝙蝠携带的 SARS 类冠状病毒，

cues.en: from bats for a long period of time. And this is why you can see the 11/18/2019
cues.zh: 这就是为什么你会看到 2019 年 11 月 18 日的

cues.en: job posting asking for more researchers to join the project.
cues.zh: 招聘启事，招募更多研究人员加入这个项目。

cues.en: During this time, we don't know much, but the December 24 posting acknowledges that they've made a big discovery in human transmissibility
cues.zh: 这段时间我们所知不多，但 12 月 24 日的招聘启事承认，他们在病毒的人际传播能力方面有了重大发现，

cues.en: and they need more help to deal with it. So that's where it got kind of spooky.
cues.zh: 并且需要更多人手来应对。这就让事情变得有点诡异了。

cues.en: During my research, a name kept popping up,
cues.zh: 调查过程中，一个名字不断出现，

cues.en: Huang Yealeng.
cues.zh: Huang Yealeng。

cues.en: Huang Yealeng was a researcher in the lab working on the virology of bats with Shi Zhengli and she's missing.
cues.zh: Huang Yealeng 是实验室的研究人员，和 Shi Zhengli 一起研究蝙蝠病毒学；她失踪了。

cues.en: Most people believe her to be patient zero and most people believe she's dead. Shi Zhengli, you know, the head lab leader, told the government that she swears on her life that she isn't dead nor was she infected.
cues.zh: 大多数人认为她是零号病人，也认为她已经死了。Shi Zhengli，也就是实验室负责人，向政府发誓说她没死，也没有感染。

cues.en: However, all of her info on the Wuhan lab website, you know where I found the job posting, it's gone. So if you look here, if you go to the actual virology website, you can see all the people that were working here or were students.
cues.zh: 不过，武汉病毒研究所网站上所有关于她的信息都消失了，我就是在那个网站上找到招聘启事的。你看这里，打开实际的病毒学网站，就能看到曾在这里工作或就读的所有人。

cues.en: They all have their bios still up, whether or not they moved on from the Wuhan lab.
cues.zh: 他们的个人简介都还在，不管他们后来是否离开了武汉病毒研究所。

cues.en: But if you can see,
cues.zh: 但如果你能看到，

cues.en: Huang Yanling's profile has completely vanished. Her picture is gone and now her bio is gone as well. But if you go to the other students, all their bios remain intact.
cues.zh: Huang Yanling 的个人资料已经完全消失。她的照片没了，现在简介也没了。但如果你去看其他学生，他们的简介都还完好无损。

cues.en: No one has seen her and the government has posted a notice instead of any information about her on the lab website stating that there were rumors of her disappearance,
cues.zh: 没人见过她，政府没有在实验室网站上公布她的任何信息，而是贴出通知，称有她失踪的谣言，

cues.en: but she's alive and well
cues.zh: 但她还活着，而且一切都好

cues.en: without giving an ounce of proof of course.
cues.zh: 当然，一点证据都没给。

cues.en: Everyone on the Chinese internet is searching for her, but most believe that her body was quickly cremated and the people working at the crematorium were perhaps infected as they were not given any information about the virus. It was a secret after all.
cues.zh: 中国互联网上人人都在找她，但大多数人认为她的遗体被迅速火化了，而火葬场的工作人员可能也被感染了，因为他们没得到任何关于病毒的信息。毕竟这是个秘密。

cues.en: The thing is, this has sparked a massive discussion on the Chinese Internet,
cues.zh: 问题是，这在中国互联网上引发了大规模讨论，

cues.en: and most of the articles get scrubbed pretty quickly, but I found a lot of good points. Now the thing is the CCP put up this kind of notice saying that she's totally alive and everything's okay and don't believe these rumors. But but if you've been in China, you know how how much the CCP actually hates rumors.
cues.zh: 大多数文章很快就被清理了，但我发现了不少好观点。问题是，CCP 贴出这种通知，说她完全活着，一切都好，不要相信这些谣言。但，但如果你在中国待过，你就知道 CCP 实际上有多痛恨谣言。

cues.en: And if Huang Yanling is truly alive like they claim, why is her photo and bio removed? The other associates and graduates remain on the website even after moving to other positions at different labs or different universities.
cues.zh: 而且，如果 Huang Yanling 真像他们说的那样活着，为什么她的照片和简介被删了？其他研究人员和毕业生即使去了不同实验室或不同大学的其他岗位，也仍然留在网站上。

cues.en: The first thing that the government would do, the CCP that I know at least,
cues.zh: 政府会做的第一件事，至少是我所了解的那个 CCP，

cues.en: the first thing they would do to quash this rumor is to make her have a public appearance. Then people would stop talking about it. Yet people are still looking for her and can't find her. And I'm not talking about normal medicines. I'm talking about PhDs. I'm talking about scientists, I'm talking about professors.
cues.zh: 他们要平息这个谣言，第一件事就是让她公开露面。然后人们就不会再谈论了。可人们仍在找她，却找不到她。我说的不是普通医生。我说的是博士。我说的是科学家，是教授。

cues.en: And this is where it kind of started to come together. On 02/06/2020,
cues.zh: 事情大概就是从这里开始串起来的。2020年2月6日，

cues.en: Xiaobo Tao, he was a professor, he posted a thesis
cues.zh: Xiaobo Tao，他是一名教授，他发了一篇论文

cues.en: about details that he knew about, but he wasn't supposed to talk about. I see some kind of, links to people like Li Wen Liang who wanted to say something, but they couldn't, but Xiaobo Tao, the professor, he posted the information anyway.
cues.zh: 讲的是他知道但不该说的一些细节。我看到一些和 Li Wen Liang 这类人的关联，他们想说点什么，但说不出来，而 Xiaobo Tao 这位教授还是把信息发了出来。

cues.en: He knew researchers at the lab that were infected and they had already begun self quarantine after they showed symptoms of being infected.
cues.zh: 他知道实验室里有研究人员被感染了，他们在出现感染症状后已经开始自我隔离。

cues.en: And the majority of the researchers at the lab were already suspicious that this virus that they were coming down with was from bats. The professor directly pointed out that the main source of the virus, is from the Wuhan lab, which is only 300 or actually 280
cues.zh: 而且实验室里大多数研究人员已经怀疑，他们染上的这种病毒来自蝙蝠。这位教授直接指出，病毒的主要来源是武汉实验室，而那里距离只有 300，实际上 280

cues.en: meters to be exact from the Huanan seafood market where it was originally claimed to have originated.
cues.zh: 米，准确地说，距离最初声称的起源地华南海鲜市场。

cues.en: He also claims that it is not a natural infection, infection, so not something that people would have just come across in nature. He also gives a clear timeline and has information that researchers were splashed with urine and blood samples from all the bats that were collected. Not only that, he also knew exactly how many bats were collected in the lab. Now pairing the researcher Huang Yanling's disappearance with the fact that people
cues.zh: 他还声称这不是自然感染，不是人们在自然界中偶然遇到的那种感染。他还给出了明确的时间线，并掌握了研究人员被采集来的蝙蝠尿液和血液样本溅到的消息。不仅如此，他还确切知道实验室里收集了多少只蝙蝠。现在，把研究人员 Huang Yanling 失踪一事，与有人声称在实验室工作时被装有冠状病毒的试管溅到这件事联系起来，再加上她在网上的所有信息都被彻底清除，而这一切都发生在距离华南四福市场仅 280 米的实验室里。相关实验室当时正在研究冠状病毒从蝙蝠传播到人类的能力

cues.en: working in the lab claimed to have been splashed with coronavirus containing vials
cues.zh: 据称在实验室工作的人声称，自己曾被装有冠状病毒的试管溅到

cues.en: and her online presence has been scrubbed from existence,
cues.zh: 而她在网上的所有信息都已被彻底清除，

cues.zh: 这一切都发生在距离华南四福市场仅 280 米的实验室里；相关实验室当时正在研究冠状病毒从蝙蝠传播到人类的能力

cues.en: of coronaviruses,
cues.zh: 冠状病毒的，

cues.en: it's quite clear
cues.zh: 这已经很清楚了

cues.en: that the Chinese government needs to close its mouth and acknowledge that this in fact did come from Wuhan, Hubei, China.
cues.zh: 中国政府应该闭嘴，并承认这件事确实源自中国湖北武汉。

cues.en: I did not get into any conspiracy theories. I'm not talking about bioweapons or biolabs or anything of the sort. This was all public information
cues.zh: 我没有谈任何阴谋论。我没说什么生物武器、生物实验室之类的东西。这些都是公开信息

cues.en: on the Chinese Internet
cues.zh: 来自中国互联网

cues.en: published by researchers,
cues.zh: 由研究人员、

cues.en: scientists,
cues.zh: 科学家、

cues.en: and doctors. With the CCP's all powerful control to hide everything it can, the truth usually still finds its way out. The Chinese government should cover their tracks better next time if you're gonna blame this on Italy or The US or whatever is convenient to your narrative.
cues.zh: 和医生发布。中共拥有无所不能的控制力，想尽办法掩盖一切，但真相通常还是会浮出水面。下次如果你们还想把这事怪到意大利、美国或任何符合你们说辞的地方，中国政府最好把痕迹处理得更好些。

cues.zh: 中共的无能，以及明明从科学角度清楚了解冠状病毒及其危险性，
